Master.g4.city_config: Auto-acknowledgment text + send timing; statutory ack window where present, else city default (recommend: same business day).

Master.bn.city_config: No statutory constraint in this state — city policy.

Master.f2.city_config: Estimate-review $ threshold + reviewer role — pure city policy (recommend: supervisor review over $50).

Clarification.n3.city_config: ⚠ config-not-law for most states: response window before close. Statutory: MO 90d · TX 61d. Recommend default 30d.

Estimate-Fee.dreq.city_config: Estimate-required trigger (statutory where present; else city $ threshold — recommend: estimate when > free allowance).

Estimate-Fee.addt.label: NOT ESTIMABLE YET →
Estimate-Fee.addt.city_config: ⚠ Not-estimable-yet path (prelim search first) — pure city policy on when allowed and its operational target.

Estimate-Fee.frev.city_config: Estimate review $ threshold + reviewer role — same knob family as Master.f2.

Estimate-Fee.fcom.city_config: Estimate communication template; itemization statutory where fee.estimate_and_notice requires it.

Estimate-Fee.drsp.label: Requester response
Estimate-Fee.drsp.city_config: ⚠ config-not-law: requester response window on the estimate. Recommend default 30d.

Estimate-Fee.optout.label: opt-out / no response
Estimate-Fee.optout.city_config: ⚠ config-not-law: opt-out / no-response handling on the estimate (close vs. hold). Recommend close-as-withdrawn after window.

Estimate-Fee.ddep.city_config: Whether to exercise permissive deposit/advance-payment authority, and at what threshold (statute caps; city elects).

Estimate-Fee.cnp.label: nonpayment (MO 90d · OR 60d ·
Estimate-Fee.cnp.city_config: ⚠ nonpayment close window: statutory MO 90d · OR 60d · TX 60d · MI 45d (deposit); else city default (recommend 60d).

Denial.nreason.label: Select reason(s) from config library

denial.agency_burden.summary: An agency must justify withholding any record by demonstrating that it is exempt under an express provision of the CPRA, or that on the facts of the particular case the public interest served by nondisclosure clearly outweighs the public interest served by disclosure.

Denial.nreason.city_config: The exemption/reason library itself is per-state config content (Phase-7 data load), keyed to statute cites.

Denial.dlegal.label: Legal approval
Denial.dlegal.city_config: Who may approve a denial (city routing); CT requires the custodian personally.

Denial.ncomm.label: Compose denial communication

denial.written_notice_required.summary: A response to a written request that includes a determination denying the request, in whole or in part, must be in writing.

denial.identify_responsible_person.summary: A notification of denial must set forth the names and titles or positions of each person responsible for the denial.

Denial.ncomm.city_config: Denial letter template — must satisfy every content element listed for the state.

Denial.ddl.label: Denial deadline?
Denial.ddl.city_config: No statutory constraint in this state — city policy.

redaction.segregability.summary: Any reasonably segregable portion of a record must be made available after deletion of the portions that are exempt by law.

Redaction.r1.city_config: The exemption library content (shared with Denial.nreason); segregability default applies in 25 states.

Redaction.pii.label: MANDATORY / AUTO-REDACT CLASSES
Redaction.pii.city_config: No statutory constraint in this state — city policy.

Redaction.r2.label: Apply redactions — mark visibly / note each

Redaction.d3.label: Legal review needed?
Redaction.d3.city_config: Legal-review escalation trigger for redactions — pure city policy (recommend: any novel exemption or protected-person class).

production.format_and_medium.summary: If information constituting a non-exempt identifiable public record is held in an electronic format, the agency must make it available in an electronic format when requested by any person.

The agency must make the information available in any electronic format in which it holds the information, and must provide a copy in the requested format if that format is one the agency has used to create copies for its own use or for other agencies.

production.delivery_and_completion.summary: Once a disclosable copy request is made, the agency must make the records promptly available (a soft-standard production deadline distinct from the 10-day determination).
production.delivery_and_completion.clock_spec: undefined-soft: "promptly" from request receipt / upon payment of duplication fees

eligibility.any_person.summary: Every person has a right to inspect any public record; the right to request/inspect is not limited to residents, citizens, or an enumerated class of requesters.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: An agency may not condition or limit access to an otherwise-disclosable public record based on the purpose for which the record is requested; requesters need not state a reason.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: Records must be made available to any person; there is no residency, citizenship, or in-state requirement to request records.

clarification.duty_to_assist.summary: To assist the requester in making a focused, effective request, the agency shall (to the extent reasonable) help identify responsive records, describe the information technology and physical location where records exist, and suggest ways to overcome any practical basis for denying access.

Clarification.deny.label: Deny as vague / overbroad

intake.reasonably_describes.summary: A copy request must reasonably describe an identifiable record or records before the duty to produce attaches.

Clarification.deny.note: Deny-as-vague is narrower than reasonably-describes membership: TN·NJ·OH, OK only after SB 535 engagement (diagram legend, v2.2).

clarification.duty_satisfied.summary: The agency's duty to help identify responsive records is deemed satisfied if it cannot identify the requested information after making a reasonable effort to elicit additional clarifying information from the requester.

Estimate-Fee.proc.label: No → proceed to work; collect at end

payment.production_conditioned_on_paymen.summary: The agency's duty is to make copies available upon payment of the duplication fees, permitting the agency to condition release of copies on payment.

Estimate-Fee.proc.note: Collect-at-end is the default path wherever production is NOT statutorily conditioned on prepayment.

Records-Search.prog.label: BUT extraction/programming of EXISTING
Records-Search.prog.note: Programming-≠-creation loop is TX 552.231 only; the broader no-duty-to-create concept (16 states) is context, not an activator.

production.website_satisfies.summary: An agency may satisfy a records-posting/production obligation by maintaining the record on its website and directing the requester there, but must promptly provide a copy if the requester cannot access or reproduce the record from the website.

payment.production_conditioned_on_paymen.summary: The agency's duty is to make copies available upon payment of the duplication fees, permitting the agency to condition release of copies on payment.

Disposition.caps.label: REQUESTOR-LEDGER CHECK (class D)
Disposition.caps.note: Requestor-ledger class-D delivery caps (OH) ride on ledger config; see ledger section.

acknowledgment.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

response.initial_decision_window.summary: Within 10 days of receiving a copy request, the agency must determine whether it seeks disclosable public records in its possession and promptly notify the requester of the determination and the reasons.
response.initial_decision_window.clock_spec: fixed: 10 days from receipt of request

response.extension_length.summary: In unusual circumstances the determination time limit may be extended by written notice, but not by more than 14 days.
response.extension_length.clock_spec: ceiling: up to 14 additional days beyond the 10-day determination deadline; requires written extension notice

response.extension_notice.summary: An extension of the determination deadline is valid only if made by written notice from the agency head or designee, setting forth the reasons for the extension and the date a determination is expected to be dispatched.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: Fees for copies of records are limited to fees covering the direct costs of duplication, or a statutory fee if one applies.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: The cost of duplicating an electronic record is limited to the direct cost of producing a copy of the record in an electronic format.

communication.determination_notice.summary: The agency must promptly notify the requester of its determination and the reasons therefor.
